summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K announcing the upcoming expiry of 18,443,495 quoted options (ASX: ATHO) on August 31, 2026. The exercise price is $0.50 per option; shares traded at $0.53 on ASX on July 28, 2026. Options not exercised by the expiry date will lapse. Trading in the options will cease on August 25, 2026. No underwriting agreement exists. This is a routine corporate event related to option expiry, not a special situation. The filing is a standard notification to option holders, with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
